A2_scaffold_counts.reason: depend only on CELL_ID scaffold and are identical for distinct legal staircase coordinate maps

B2_exact_bijection.reason: u-ray cells are reflection-fixed while off-diagonal ordered pairs are swapped; equivariant point maps can hit only diagonal pairs

B2_one_new_state_occupancy.reason: a reflection-invariant occupancy process adding exactly one raw ordered-pair state per fixed primary step can add only swap-fixed diagonal states; adding an off-diagonal orbit requires two raw states

Bm_m1_to_4.reason: all Bm(k) exist combinatorially; existence and cardinality alone do not relate a_n to saturation of any one m

T2_swap_orbit_carrier.reason: B2/swap has k(k+1)/2 orbits, identifiable with i<=j representatives, but no frozen semantics maps primary step j to a particular orbit or proves saturation

noncanonicity_witnesses.layer_orderings: Even if one postulates layer-by-layer occupancy, each nontrivial raw Bm layer admits many orderings; no current relation chooses one.
noncanonicity_witnesses.reflection_note: For B2 raw ordered pairs, most such orders also break transverse-slot reflection.
noncanonicity_witnesses.square_layer_k2: B2(2)\B2(1) has 3 states and 3!=6 possible within-layer orders.

positive_exact_meaning.proof: a_0=0 and each a_(j+1)-a_j is 0 or 1; summing increments telescopes to a_n
positive_exact_meaning.relation: a_n equals the number of realized transverse layer-crossing events among the first n primary steps
